Status.note: A WLBT article from October 22, 2025 (https://www.wlbt.com/2025/10/22/leaders-attend-new-vicksburg-advanced-power-station-groundbreaking-ceremony) reports the groundbreaking at the Baxter Wilson site. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 69223 as under construction, less than 50 percent complete. Status stays construction.

Start year.note: Entergy's Vicksburg project page (https://www.entergymississippi.com/generation/vicksburg) says construction is expected to be complete by August 2028. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) plans August 2028. Entergy's filing in docket 2025-AD-123 says the same.

Status Detail.value: Entergy Mississippi held a groundbreaking on October 21, 2025. The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality issued the air construction permit 2780-00027 on November 3, 2025.
Status Detail.note: The WLBT article is dated October 22, 2025 and says the groundbreaking was held Tuesday, which was October 21 (https://www.wlbt.com/2025/10/22/leaders-attend-new-vicksburg-advanced-power-station-groundbreaking-ceremony). The permit's issue date is in the state's permit record (https://opcgis.deq.state.ms.us/ensearchonline/get_doc.aspx?dt=finalp&id=1845094). The existing text says the permit was approved in September 2025, and the state record shows November 3, 2025.

Turbine/Engine Technology.note: The air construction permit (https://opcgis.deq.state.ms.us/ensearchonline/get_doc.aspx?dt=finalp&id=1845094) lists a gas turbine with duct burner, a heat recovery steam generator and a steam turbine generator as unit VAPS-1A.
